full_semantic_decision_read.full_chain_observation:
Registered Underzealot goals capture a valid ground-near sacrifice and startRiding without checking returned success. Target selection/hurt-alert suppressed while carrying/leader carrying/praying. Actual carrying sync flag is updated from passenger presence in server tick after super.tick.
Complete ritual goal separates follower and carrier eligibility. Followers seek ring positions, pray near altar and increment shared-looking but per-entity synced worship time; carrier >200 worship ticks plus >=3 praying followers triggers passenger.triggerSacrificeIn(300), then consumes local cloudCooldown400 and publishes event62. Validity/altar/position/digging and stop logic differ from later victim countdown.
Native hurt calls super first; only true plus isVehicle plus random<.65 ejects passengers. It does not itself clear victim isBeingSacrificed/sacrificeTime or immediately set carrying false. Goal stop resets worship/praying/particle position, ejects and conditionally sets carrier cooldown100. No rollback callback to committed victim timer.
Actual Gloomoth tick decrements armed sacrificeTime on server regardless of still being a passenger, then attempts Watcher conversion below0. Carrier postSacrifice/cooldown/advancement requires current Underzealot vehicle, but conversion does not. Vesper tick additionally requires isPassenger, so dismount pauses its timer without clearing the armed flag; later any passenger relation resumes, and conversion still does not require an Underzealot vehicle. Both trigger methods simply arm and replace timer.
Client events61/62 create particles/cloud,77 requests chant. ClientProxy type5 reuses sound by integer entity id and isSameEntity/alive; queues only if absent from queued/ticking lists and canPlaySound. UnderzealotSound canPlay requires !silent/praying/worship<MAX; running tick checks alive/praying, updates position/volume/pitch and stops otherwise. It does not itself stop when worship crosses MAX or silent changes. Removal clears map entry; no sound-manager stop call in that removal helper.
Native render burrow gate can suppress body; model carrying/praying interpolation reshapes pose, and armFreedom suppresses ordinary swing while carrying. These are state cues, not damage rejection text or verified visual feedback. Buried targetability/push/pick filters differ from hurt: own isInvulnerableTo only adds IN_WALL and super, not blanket buried invulnerability.

full_chain.observation: Actual @Mod common setup registers ReviveEventServer and all three packets; player AttachCapabilities provides LazyOptional<Bleeding>. HIGHEST LivingDeath on server requires active configuration (creative exception, singleplayer flag or published server) and non-bypass source. A first qualifying death removes the player from helper lists, sends helper-stop, calls knockOut via startBleeding, dismounts if needed, cancels death, adjusts hunger and health. knockOut initializes bleeding/progress/downedTime/timeLeft and saves source/tracker. Already-bleeding death clears current helpers and returns without cancelling; bypass sources skip this entire block. Native Forge listener composition is not verified.

LivingHurt first checks bleeding, then lets bypass sources through. Otherwise bledOut, downedTime <= initialDamageCooldown, and independently configured player/mob/other source categories can setCanceled(true). Initial grace is inclusive; flags do not form universal invulnerability. Nonbleeding helper damage optionally removes helper membership. Death/Hurt and active-check conditions differ; hurt listener has no isReviveActive condition. PlayerMixin visibility and optional push refusal read the same state. These generic predicates are support0 under the one cooperative mechanism.

Server EntityInteract targeting a bleeding player cancels the interaction. Optional required item checks helper main hand; first consumptive admission shrinks one unless creative, sets inventory changed and target itemConsumed. Once itemConsumed is true, later admissions still enter the else-if ingredient check, but do not shrink again. After these checks, removePlayerAsHelper removes the helper from every current server player list, then adds it to this target and sends HelperPacket(targetUUID,true). The handler itself has no explicit helper-alive/nonbleeding, distance, same-dimension or line-of-sight guard; native interaction pipeline constraints not expanded. Failed item check leaves old membership unchanged. Removal-before-add prevents ordinary repeated interaction from accumulating duplicate entries, not arbitrary API mutations.

full_chain.stage: competing progress and bleed timer consumer
full_chain.observation: Server START PlayerTick requires active configuration and alive target, then ticks only bleeding state. Bleeding.tick forces swimming when current pose differs, removes helpers whose numeric distance is >maxDistance and sends stop to those helpers. It does not separately check level identity, alive, current held item, sustained button hold or current bleeding state. If no helpers OR haltBleedTime=false, decrement timeLeft; if none AND resetProgress=true, zero progress. Then add remaining helper count * progressPerPlayer, increment downedTime, and request configured helper food exhaustion. Parent sends snapshots every five downed ticks and applies configured effects/hunger before checking revived progress first, then bledOut. If both predicates true that tick, revive wins. Effects admission results ignored; progress does not depend on hunger payment success.

revive clears Bleeding state first, requests configured effects, resetPlayer sends stop to current helpers and clears list/PersistentData flag, syncs, writes healthAfter, requests revived sound, posts PlayerRevivedEvent, syncs again, releases forced pose. Event comment says before revived but actual call follows state/health writes. kill posts PlayerBleedOutEvent (not used as a returned veto), restores original combat snapshot, writes HP0, forceBledOut, calls die(saved/fallback source), clears helpers/flag with an intermediate snapshot, then clears Bleeding state and forced pose and sends final snapshot. Marking bleeding/time0 before die prevents its own first-death rescue branch from rearming. The native die result/cross-mod cancellation is not certified; reset occurs even if native death is intercepted. Logout bleeding calls kill; permission2 command directly revives bleeding targets. Optional upstream ban policy is read as context only and is never proposed for Dynasty.

ReviveUpdatePacket snapshots target UUID and serialized timeLeft/progress/bleeding/consumed. Client execution looks up that UUID in current Minecraft level, drops absent target, deserializes into capability and forces STANDING if false. HelperPacket independently writes static helpActive/helpTarget. Registered RenderGuiOverlayEvent.Post consumer shows helper target time/progress if helper is not bleeding, helpActive, GUI visible, no screen and target UUID resolves. It does not test target.isBleeding or actual helper membership. Victim overlay reads own state, applies pose/handsBusy/missTime and local jump effect; on nonbleeding overlay it restores post effect, clears jump/handsBusy and explicitly stops owned sound. Low-level CreativeCore delivery, native graphics/shader/audio engine internals are not expanded; no visual/audio success claim.

full_chain.observation: removePlayerAsHelper only removes from server lists and sends no HelperPacket. Damage abort calls only that helper. Therefore under abortOnDamage=true, a removed helper can retain helpActive=true and a resolved old target overlay: later target reset iterates remaining helpers, so it does not notify the removed one. Distance pruning does send stop; switching targets sends a new start; first knockOut of the helper sends stop; target normal revive/kill sends stop to helpers still present. A bypass-source death skips the playerDied helper cleanup, and already-bleeding non-bypass death only clears helpers there, not all bleeding state. These are static branch observations, not runtime reproduced defects. No claim every death/logout/dimension change is covered.

Client END tick increments a local hold counter while bleeding and attack held; sends GiveUpPacket only when prior counter > seconds*20 then resets it. Server checks only sender bleeding before kill, not hold duration. Render callback has no per-overlay-type filter here, so do not infer one call per frame. Helper static fields have no disconnect/session reset in the complete local Java files; target lookup includes current world but packet carries no dimension/session/sequence and no queue. If player is null, render cleanup does not run; absence of a drawn target is not clearing helpActive. Audio TensionSound tick is empty, so owned sound stop must not be inferred from that wrapper alone. These are support limits, not extra UI/transport credits.
